name: fallback-courier-new
note: Firefox-specific font-fallback fixture: the engine resolves the unregistered family 'Courier New' through the firefox fallback table to the registered Source Code Pro face, whose advances Gecko reproduces for Courier New (the oracle measures the same sub-pixel widths). Proves the browser-config fallback path: unregistered-family text measures and lays out identically to Firefox.
